meta_description: obleek is a budget tracker for Android. Track income, expenses, cards, cash and debts, organize categories your way, and get insights. It's that simple.
og_description: Track income, expenses, cards, cash and debts. Organize categories your way. Get insights. It's that simple.
twitter_description: Track income, expenses, cards, cash and debts. It's that simple.
jsonld_description: A budget tracker for Android: track income, expenses, transfers and debts across cash, cards, and accounts, organize your own categories, and see insights.
hero_h1: Track your money. Get insights. It's that simple.
hero_lede: obleek is a budget tracker for Android — income, expenses, transfers and debts across cash, cards and accounts, all in one app.
feature1_h2: See where your money goes. It's that simple.
feature1_p: Every transaction lands in one feed. See what came in, what went out, and where it went — by category, by month, over the last six months.
feature1_li1: Income, expenses, transfers and debts in one feed
feature1_li2: Daily activity heatmap and category breakdowns
feature2_h2: Organize categories how you want it. It's that simple.
feature2_p: Build your own category tree, nested up to four levels deep, each with its own icon. Reorder by dragging, archive what you no longer use, and keep expense and income categories separate.
feature2_li1: Nested categories, up to 4 levels deep
feature2_li2: Archive instead of losing your history
feature3_h2: Your cards, cash and debts in one app. It's that simple.
feature3_p: Cash, debit and credit cards, deposits — every account lives in one list, in its own currency, rolled up into a single total. Track what you owe and what's owed to you alongside everything else.
feature3_li1: Cash, cards and deposits as accounts
feature3_li2: Track money you've lent or borrowed
feature3_li3: One balance, broken down by currency
feature3_li4: Archive an account without losing its history
highlights_h2: More features that make tracking money easier
highlights_p: Recurring bills, multiple currencies, a lock screen, and transaction search.
row_demo_p: Explore obleek with sample accounts and transactions already filled in — nothing to set up first.
row_recurring_p: Set up a bill or paycheck once — daily, weekly, monthly or yearly — and edit or skip a single occurrence without breaking the series.
row_currency_p: Every account keeps its own currency, converted into one total balance using current exchange rates.
row_lock_p: Lock the app with a PIN or your fingerprint. Nothing opens without it.
row_importexport_p: Your data, in plain JSON, whenever you want it.
row_search_p: Find any transaction in seconds — by category, account, place, person or note.
row_tags_p: Attach tags, a place, or a person to any transaction — so “who” and “where” are as easy to find as “how much.”
cta_h2: Try obleek today. It's that simple.
cta_p: Explore with sample data first, or start tracking right away.
